name: Zigbee2MQTT
description: In the inspected Zigbee2MQTT OTA extension, update checks and updates can use a supplied URL or locally written hex image and are delegated to zigbee-herdsman; this source snapshot does not establish the dependency's transport or firmware-signature enforcement.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not the historical Zigbee2MQTT release.
zigbee-herdsman implementation, firmware catalogs, transport configuration, and device-side signature checks were not reviewed; no absence of authentication is inferred.
